# Open questions (owner decisions)

Each question has a **recommended default** so work can continue. The owner confirms or changes it; the
builder must not decide these alone. When a question is answered, move it to **Answered** with the decision,
the date and where the decision is recorded.

| # | Question | Why it matters | Default (used until decided) | Needed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q33 | May a cup's extra substitution (`substitutions.extra_in_extra_time`) be used before extra time starts (`AWAITING_EXTRA_TIME`, a break the definition doesn't flag `overtime`)? IFAB allows it | A scorer changing players just before extra time is refused the extra one | Counted from the first overtime `PLAY` period's start; a definition flag or a rule later if needed | S12 (or the T4 template) |
| Q34 | Should a change to what a generator produces for the same input (a fix to `KNOCKOUT@1`'s placement, say) require a new format version or a hash-scheme marker, so stored draws keep reproducing? (review #83 Q1) | The output hash names the format code and version, not the generator's code; S09/S10 store draws with their hash and re-run them | A generator's output for a given format version never changes; the pinned-hash test guards it, and a change means a new format version | S09 (draw records) |
| Q46 | Should an external identifier's `validFrom` after the tenant's today be refused (on create and `person.external_id.add`)? Today it is accepted, and such an identifier can't be ended until that date: `validTo` must be ≥ `validFrom` and ≤ today, and identifiers are never edited (S06-T3b pre-review) | A mistyped future start date (2027 for 2026) leaves an identifier nobody can end or correct until then | Accepted as sent; the end is refused with `422 PERSON_EXTERNAL_ID_VALIDITY_INVALID` until the start date | S06-T4 (or the T7 identifier screens); the web caps "valid from" at the tenant's today (owner, S06-T7c-2a plan, 2026-11-20), the API still accepts a later one |
| Q47 | Should external identifier values be compared without case? Today the exact check (create, the duplicate check, `person.external_id.add`) and the unique index compare them as stored (trimmed), so `KM-2026-0147` and `km-2026-0147` can be given to two people (review #100 Q1) | A registration number typed in another case gets around D10's "a value is never reused" and the duplicate check misses it | Exact, as D10 says (trimmed only); a change touches create, the check and the unique index (a migration) | The import slice (owner, S06-T7c-2a plan, 2026-11-20: deferred, exact until then) |
| Q51 | Only football is published until S15–S16. Is a DEMO seed with football teams only, and the multi-sport rule shown by test definitions, acceptable for S07? (S06 slice review) | The outline asks for the multi-sport clubs' rugby and basketball teams, which can't be created before their definitions exist (a team's variant must be enabled) | Yes: football teams only; the clubs and venues are seeded whole; rugby and basketball teams join the seed with S15 and S16; tests use `TestSportDefinitions` (as S05 D18) | S07-T3, T7 (S07 D22) |
| Q52 | Are organisations, teams and venues public without a per-record switch? (S06 slice review) | A tenant may want to hide a team it is still setting up; people have a switch because they are personal data | No switch: every status but `ARCHIVED` is public, `PUBLIC` fields only; an organisation's email and phone are `INTERNAL` | S07-T5 (S07 D16, D17) |
